module: "freeroamSelector" backend of the grid selector (gridSelector): the screen where you choose a level and a spawn point for freeroam mode. It collects the tiles via the hook onGameplaySelectorGetTiles (keeping those whose validBackends contains freeroamSelector), handles filters (source, map size, region), search, favorites, recents and display options (saved in /settings/freeroamSelectorData.json), builds the tile details via onGameplaySelectorGetDetails and sends snapshots back to the interface by guihooks. It also knows the routes of the freeroam wizard (level, vehicle, options, multiplayer) in the menu and in pause.
usage:
-- open the selector to choose a spawn point and receive the choice
ui_freeroamSelector_general.openFreeroamSelectorForFreeroamConfigurator(function(levelName, spawnPointName)
  log('I', 'mod', levelName .. ' / ' .. tostring(spawnPointName))
end)
notes: The tiles and filters are recomputed on next access when gameplayDataChanged is true: this happens on onModActivated, onModDeactivated, onModManagerReady, onModManagerStateChanged, onSettingsChanged and onLanguageChanged.

Filters defined: source (official, mod), mapSize (steps 0, 1024², 2048², 4096², 8192², 16384²; the level's area is compared to the steps) and region. The text search covers the name, the level, the translated property values and the tile's optional filter hook (item.filterHook).

Display options: groupMode, clusterMode, displaySize (list, tiny, small, medium, large, huge; saved), showAuxContent (saved), sorting, showRecentMode, showFavouritesMode and defaultFreeroamAction ("startFreeroam" or "configureFreeroam", default "configureFreeroam", saved). The data version is 13.
Several functions accept an optional requestId: if provided, a snapshot is emitted via freeroamSelectorDisplayDataSnapshot so that the Vue interface ignores stale responses.
The default root path is { keys = {"allFreeroam"} }, whereas the breadcrumbs use "allGameplay": tiles.getTiles treats any unknown path as allGameplay, so the result is identical.

getDisplayDataOptions, setDisplayDataOption, resetDisplayDataToDefaults and updateFilterData do not call ensureInstances: they assume the instances have already been created (by getGameplayData, getDisplayData…), otherwise an error on nil.
exploreFolder and goToMod only log (TODO); getManagementDetails always returns { buttons = {} } and profilerFinish does nothing.
In getScreenHeaderTitleAndPath, string.format("%s", clusterKey, groupKey, groupName) receives extra arguments (ignored).
The field M.displayDataInstance is also exposed after the first initialization.

dependencies.desc: Extensions loaded before this one: ui_gameplaySelector_tiles and core_locales.

getUiData.desc: Returns the selector data: items, displayData, filterList, activeFilters, lockedFiltersByProp and backendName. Loads the tiles if needed.

getGameplayData.desc: Returns the selector data (tiles filtered by validBackends, filters, display options), recomputes them if the mods, settings or language have changed, and creates them on first request.

returns.desc: Table items, filterList, activeFilters, lockedFiltersByProp, displayData.

getTiles.desc: Returns the tile groups for a path, via ui_gameplaySelector_tiles.getTiles. Clears the first group's label if it is "freeroam".

passesFilters.desc: Indicates whether a tile passes the filters, the search and the showAuxContent option; an isCareerOnly tile is refused as long as displayData.showCareerContent is false.

returns.desc: true if the tile is displayed.

getDisplayData.desc: Returns the current display options (creates the instances if needed).

updateFilterData.desc: Updates an internal datum of the filters module (filterInstance.updateData).

clearAllFilters.desc: Clears all filters. Emits a snapshot if requestId is provided.

isFavourite.desc: Indicates whether a tile is a favorite.

toggleFavourite.desc: Toggles a tile's favorite status and returns the new state.

isRecent.desc: Indicates whether a tile is among the recent items.

trackRecent.desc: Records a tile as recently used.

getFilters.desc: Returns the filter definition (list, locked filters) after loading the data.

updateFilters.desc: Directly applies a complete filterByProp table, for example to restore the wizard's saved state without replaying the clicks. Locked filters are kept.

toggleFilter.desc: Enables or disables a filter value. Emits a snapshot if requestId is provided.

updateRangeFilter.desc: Sets the bounds of a range filter. Emits a snapshot if requestId is provided.

resetRangeFilter.desc: Resets a range filter. Emits a snapshot if requestId is provided.

resetSetFilter.desc: Resets a multiple-choice filter. Emits a snapshot if requestId is provided.

setSearchText.desc: Sets the search text. Emits a snapshot if requestId is provided.

getDisplayDataOptions.desc: Returns the display options definition. The instances must already exist.

setDisplayDataOption.desc: Sets a display option and returns the updated display data. Emits a snapshot if requestId is provided. Used for example by levelTiles.setAlwaysShowDialogue.

resetDisplayDataToDefaults.desc: Resets the display options to their default values. Emits a snapshot if requestId is provided.

getScreenHeaderTitleAndPath.desc: Builds the screen title and the breadcrumb (menu, freeroam selector, optional filters or search segment, current level or group). Uses customRootPath if it was set by openFreeroamSelectorForFreeroamConfigurator.

closedFromUI.desc: Called when the interface closes the selector: clears the custom details buttons and the custom root path, then emits the hook onFreeroamSelectorClosed.

getDetails.desc: Builds a tile's details by emitting the hook onGameplaySelectorGetDetails (the tile generators add their block to it) and returns the first block.

returns.desc: Details block, nil if no generator responded.

requestDetails.desc: Builds a tile's details and sends them to the interface via the event freeroamSelectorDetails, with backendName, requestId, item and details.

setCurrentSelectorPath.desc: Stores the path of the visible view, so that emitDisplayDataSnapshot rebuilds the snapshot on the right path. An invalid path is ignored; nil goes back to the root path.

resolveCurrentSelectorPath.desc: Returns the current view's path, or the default root path { keys = {"allFreeroam"} } if none was stored.

emitDisplayDataSnapshot.desc: Rebuilds the current view's snapshot (ui_gridSelector.getSelectorSnapshot, under pcall) and sends it to the interface via the event freeroamSelectorDisplayDataSnapshot with the requestId. Logs an error and returns false on failure.

returns.desc: true if the event was sent.

setCustomDetailsButtons.desc: Replaces the details buttons with a custom list (nil empties it). Each button has callback(levelName, spawnPointName, key) and meta (label, icon, primary, isDoubleClickAction, trackRecent).

getCustomDetailsButtons.desc: Returns the custom details buttons (used by levelTiles).

returns.desc: List of buttons, empty by default.

executeButton.desc: Runs the details button with the given identifier via the buttonModule.

additionalData.desc: Extra data passed to the callback.

getManagementDetails.desc: Always returns { buttons = {} } (TODO in the code).

executeDoubleClick.desc: Runs the button marked isDoubleClickAction in a tile's details (or the only button if there is just one).

goToMod.desc: Only logs the mod id (not implemented).

openFreeroamSelector.desc: Clears the filters, sets groupMode to "system" and clusterMode to "automatic", enables the "freeroam" system filter and navigates to the route "menu.gameplay".

openFromPause.desc: Opens the freeroam wizard from the pause menu, on the step configured in the setting freeroamSetupDefaultStep (level by default; level, vehicle, options or multiplayer), with returnRoute = "pause".

openFreeroamSelectorForFreeroamConfigura.desc: Opens the selector to choose a spawn point: installs a "Select spawnpoint" button whose callback receives (levelName, spawnPointName), sets its own breadcrumb, navigates to "menu.freeroamselector" and emits the hook onFreeroamSelectorOpen.

callback.desc: Function called with levelName and spawnPointName on selection.

onModDeactivated.desc: Hook called when a mod is deactivated: marks the data as needing recomputation.

onModActivated.desc: Hook called when a mod is activated: marks the data as needing recomputation.

onModManagerReady.desc: Hook called when the mod manager is ready: marks the data as needing recomputation.

onModManagerStateChanged.desc: Hook called when the mod manager state changes: marks the data as needing recomputation.

onSettingsChanged.desc: Hook called when the settings change: marks the data as needing recomputation.

onLanguageChanged.desc: Hook called when the language changes: marks the data as needing recomputation.
